detail.longDescription: Scrubbing secrets from a child process's environment does nothing if the child can read its parent's. Novee on Gemini CLI in GitHub Actions: sanitizeEnvironment stripped secrets before spawning the model's shell command, but both shared a UID and PID namespace, so cat /proc/$PPID/environ returned GITHUB_TOKEN. No unshare, no hidepid. Google rated it 10.0. https:// novee.security/blog/critical-f laws-in-anthropic-google-and-openais-coding-agents/ # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # DevOps
